title: United States NIST Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0 & GenAI Profile)

institutional_author.name: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)

summary: Release of the NIST AI RMF Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile (NIST AI 600-1) pursuant to Executive Order 14110, adding 12 specific GenAI risk categories (CBRN capabilities, confabulation, dangerous/violent recommendations, data privacy, environmental impacts, information integrity, intellectual property, value chain security) and over 200 suggested actions across GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE.
